title: What I learned from traveling full time
en: it has been a long time since i ventured beyond my county i took a needed trip to the coast to visit my father i spent some of my childhood here and it is a place full of memories consequently i found myself reflecting on my life and how far i've come and being satisfied with what i have so

as the daughter of a military man i traveled a lot as a child having grown up in many parts of the u.s cuba puerto rico italy and ireland i was always moving and while i wouldn't trade my childhood for the world i also yearned for a stable community friendships that didn't have to be long distance and a closer connection to a specific place i could call home now i barely venture out of my county much less my state while there are lands i still plan to see someday i'm content to explore my own home discovering new things and learning about the environment i live in staying put has given me a chance to observe the seasons in one place

and notice the changes from year to year traveling is wonderful but it doesn't always need to involve far away places sometimes it's simply an exploration of one's local area or if you are in a particularly adventurous mood an exploration of your own spirit there's so much to discover about oneself that is the one journey that is never

over and is always available to take external experiences are fleeting but your inner self is the one that you carry with you wherever you go and yet oftentimes it is forgotten in the midst of busyness while exciting new experiences can be life-changing and memorable it is the little more ordinary details that take up the majority of our time and it is often the part of the story that only you truly know in a way that gives us power to make it whatever we wish it to be who we truly are is not always seen by

other people it is also our thoughts our ideas and feelings we can show each other where we've traveled and what we've achieved it is much harder to communicate who we are on the inside and yet that is the only thing we carry with us all the time i believe we can be very well traveled without physically going anywhere we can explore our imaginations our questions our spiritual perspectives
do do if you are unable to travel do not feel as if you are missing out you can always choose to go on a journey simply of a different kind
and it is no less meaningful you
zh: 自从我冒险离开我的县城以来，我进行了一次必要的旅行，去拜访我的父亲，我在这里度过了我的童年时光，这是一个充满回忆的地方，因此我发现自己反思了我的生活以及我已经走了多远，并对我所拥有的感到满意
作为一名军人的女儿，我小时候去过很多地方，在美国的许多地方长大，古巴，波多黎各，意大利和爱尔兰，我总是在搬家，虽然我不会用我的童年去换取世界，但我也渴望有一个稳定的社区友谊，这种友谊不需要很远的距离，并且与我可以称之为家的特定地方有更紧密的联系。探索我自己的家，发现新事物并了解我所居住的环境，让我有机会在一个地方观察季节
并注意每年的变化旅行是美妙的，但它并不总是需要涉及遥远的地方，有时它只是对当地区域的探索，或者如果你处于一种特别冒险的心情，对自己精神的探索，有很多东西需要发现自己，这是一次从未有过的旅行
外在的经历转瞬即逝，但你的内在自我是你随身携带的，无论你走到哪里，但常常会在忙碌中被遗忘，而令人兴奋的新经历可以改变生活，令人难忘，一些更普通的细节占据了我们大部分的时间，它往往是故事的一部分，只有你真正知道，以一种方式赋予我们力量，让我们成为真正的自己，但我们并不总是能看到真实的自己。
对其他人来说，这也是我们的想法、我们的想法和感受，我们可以向对方展示我们去过的地方和我们所取得的成就，要传达我们的内心是谁要困难得多，但这是我们一直随身携带的唯一东西，我相信我们不需要亲自去任何地方就可以很好地旅行，我们可以探索我们的想象力，我们的问题，我们的精神观点
如果您无法旅行，请这样做 不要觉得自己错过了您随时可以选择进行一次不同类型的旅行
这对你来说同样有意义
